Common.disclaimer: Tarot at ArcanaVerse is for entertainment and self-reflection, not a substitute for professional advice.
Common.copyright: A quiet space to look again.

Home.title: Choose a card. Notice what is present.
Home.subtitle: Three bilingual spreads, designed for a slower and more intentional reading.
Home.spreadsTitle: How would you like to see the question?
Home.spreadsBody: Each spread opens a different depth. There is no right choice, only the one that fits this moment.
Home.ritualTitle: You do not need to rush an answer.
Home.ritualBody: Write a question if you wish. Shuffle, choose by instinct, then reveal each position in order.
Home.ritualNote: All data stays in your browser for the current session.

Reading.setupTitle: Place your question in the quiet
Reading.setupBody: Write what is on your mind, or leave the field empty and hold the question silently.
Reading.spreadsBody: Each spread opens a distinct depth and perspective for your question.
Reading.selectDeckBody: Each deck carries its own distinct atmosphere, visual energy, and artistic voice.
Reading.dragOrTapHint: Drag a card into a dashed slot below, or tap a card to auto-place it
Reading.questionPlaceholder: What needs to become clearer now?
Reading.questionHelp: Optional, up to 2,000 characters. The text never leaves your browser.
Reading.shufflingHint: Take one slow breath and hold the question in mind.
Reading.selectBody: Tap the cards that draw your attention. Each card can be chosen once.
Reading.readyBody: You will reveal them one at a time in the order of the spread.
Reading.completedBody: Read the spread again as a story, not a verdict.
Reading.restoreNotice: Your previous reading session was restored.
Reading.cardUnavailable: Card data could not be found.
Reading.mobileCanvasHint: Swipe horizontally to view the full Celtic Cross layout.
Reading.tapToReveal: Activate to reveal the next card

Login.title: Sign in to your space
Login.body: This form only demonstrates the interface. There is no real account and your password is never stored.
Login.passwordHelp: The password is checked in memory and discarded immediately.
Login.passwordError: Password must contain at least 12 characters.
Login.success: You are signed in in demo mode.

Credits.title: Every image has a clear source.
Credits.body: The 78 card faces use 1910 Rider-Waite-Smith scans from Wikimedia Commons. The card back and hero are original assets created for ArcanaVerse.
Credits.deckBody: Illustrated by Pamela Colman Smith. Wikimedia Commons marks the files in this set with Public Domain Mark 1.0.
Credits.generatedBody: The hero and card back were generated with OpenAI's image tool from a minimalist brief, without third-party logos or content.
Credits.manifest: A per-card source manifest is stored alongside the assets in the project.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.body: This path is not part of the current ArcanaVerse experience.
